description.value: The Lasqueti Arts Centre is a community arts facility on Lasqueti Island, a small off-grid island in Georgia Strait accessible only by foot-passenger ferry from French Creek on Vancouver Island. The island has no paved roads and no BC Hydro service, giving it a distinctly remote, back-to-the-land character that informs its arts community. Cyclists reaching the island travel unpaved roads to explore a settlement whose culture stretches from Indigenous heritage to 1970s homesteaders.
